title: geranium wilfordii var. chinense
intro: Geranium wilfordii var. chinense, commonly known as Chinese Geranium, is a species of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Geranium include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which help to relieve pain, reduce fever, and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
